trends_method.mid_anchor: ai photo to video — confirmed queryable in every geography and window tested.
rules: 0-100 values are relative interest in that single request (same keywords, same geo, same window). They are not monthly search volume and not a share of searches.
Do not compare raw index values across different requests, geos, or windows; each request is independently normalized to 100.
A mid-anchor shared across groups does not make two groups' raw curves directly comparable.
Wide baseline ai video generator flattens smaller terms if placed in the same chart; that is why candidates were compared to the mid-anchor, not to ai video generator, in the same request.
null / missing points mean insufficient Trends data, not proven zero demand.
A literal 0 is not the same as null.
Jatayu being India-primary was only a hypothesis from the name; US, India, and worldwide were queried separately.
